title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE EMPLOYMENT OF FIVE ADDITIONAL CLERKS OF CLASS NINE IN THE OFFICE OF THE AUDITOR OF THE PHILIPPINE ARCHIPELAGO, AND MAKING AN APPROPRIATION THEREFOR, AND ALSO APPROPRIATING FIVE HUNDRED DOLLARS AS A DEFICIENCY TO PAY TEMPORARY CLERKS PREVIOUSLY AUTHORIZED.

text.en:
Authority is hereby given for the employment of five additional clerks of class nine in the office
of the Auditor of the Philippine Archipelago, and the sum of eight hundred and thirty-three dollars and thirty-
three cents is hereby appropriated for the payment of the salaries thereof from the eleventh day of November,
nineteen hundred and one, to and including the thirty-first day of December, nineteen hundred and one.

The sum of five hundred dollars is hereby appropriated as a deficiency appropriation to pay
temporary clerks heretofore employed in the office of the Auditor of the Philippine Archipelago for bringing
up arrears of work.
The term "dollars" wherever used in this Act means dollars in money of the United States.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 11, 1901.
